changes.rationale: Close artifact-gate-holes. Its three holes are fixed and each has a test under the task-artifacts requirement: page order is read from the branch tip CI passes as handoff --head, or from the second parent of a merge on the base (handoff_reads_the_branchs_commits_from_a_pull_request_merge); before-code order is checked for partial records at handoff (a_partial_handoff_checks_that_the_brief_came_before_code); a required page needs 1,200 characters outside its tags and styles (a_placeholder_page_is_refused). The floor stops a placeholder, not filler; the gap's next_action says when to reopen.

Cut the task-page ceremony and close its gate holes. Task records gain schema version 7 with tiers small, standard and full, and a reader field; a record without a tier is standard and now owes two pages (brief.html before code, report.html at or after the last code commit) where it owed eight. The eight-page set stays as the full tier, written without interview.html and quiz.html unless the record names a human reader. Schema 6 records keep their old meaning and stay valid, so no archived record changes what it owes. This lowers the default page requirement on purpose: five merged tasks wrote 3,235 to 5,159 lines of HTML for 209 to 773 lines of change, and no owner answered a discovery page. The gates get stricter in three places: handoff checks before-code order for partial records, reads the branch's commits on a pull request's merge commit (--head, passed by .github/workflows/ci.yml), and refuses a required page under 1,200 characters outside its tags and styles. The small tier's limits and the protected path list are unchanged. AGENTS.md, docs/COMPLETION.md, the ceremony skills, agent descriptions, the PR template and scripts/agent-artifact-write.sh say the same. harness/readiness.json lists the seven new tests under task-artifacts.
